newsitem.title: CANADA: CN opens Gateway Intermodal Terminal.
newsitem.headline: CN opens Gateway Intermodal Terminal.

text.p: Canadian National Railway Co said on Monday that it opened its C$20 million Gateway Intermodal Terminal in Harvey, Ilinois, south of Chicago.
CN said its intermodal business had grown more than 22 percent since May 1995 when CN opened its C$200 million St Clair tunnel between Sarnia, Ontario and Port Huron, Michigan.

It said Gateway Intermodal Terminal could handle almost 250,000 lifts a year and store 2,065 containers and 1,100 trailers. The terminal's two 7,200-foot loading tracks could handle doublestack trains 1.3 miles long, the railroad said.
